findings.motion: Co-author of HB 1005, requirements to vote including proof of identification
findings.note: She is listed as a co-author (not the author). The date is the day the bill was referred to the Elections committee. The introduced text widens the list of accepted IDs to include expired IDs, birth and citizenship papers, and utility bills or bank statements showing name and address, and drops the exceptions for religious objection and natural disaster. It lets a voter without an ID cast a provisional ballot by affidavit. It lowers the penalty for one offense. The bill was not taken further than committee referral on the history page.

findings.motion: Co-author of HB 1950, acceptable forms of identification for voting
findings.note: She is listed as a co-author (not the author). The date is the day the bill was referred to the Elections committee, its last action. The introduced text adds a public-college photo ID card to the accepted IDs and lets listed IDs be used if they expired up to four years earlier.
